$comment: Single source of truth for the skills this fork owns end to end. Read by scripts/lint-skills.mjs to build the --diff-audit exemption, and referenced by docs/maintaining-fork.md and .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md so the three cannot disagree about who is fork-owned. Add a skill here only when this fork authored it: upstream has no such skill, so its whole diff is the fork's reason to exist and there is no upstream rebase friction to budget. A skill the fork merely edits stays out, and its expression-layer changes still need a changeset.
